name: Personalization_Bench_2
description: A dataset intended to evaluate personalization capabilities of models by providing user-specific contexts and expected personalized responses. It measures how well models adapt content, style, and recommendations to individual user preferences across a set of tasks or prompts. Designed to benchmark personalization quality rather than raw factual accuracy alone.
evaluation_method: human_eval / BLEU or other text overlap metrics (often relies on human judgment for personalization quality)
general_score_metric: human_eval (supplemented by BLEU/ROUGE in some setups)
reputation: Relatively small community dataset with limited adoption; used mainly for research experiments on personalization.
